categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies src/streams.cpp and src/streams.h, which provide shared stream and serialization primitives across the node.
categories.rationale: Captures errno to include OS error strings in AutoFile/BufferedFile failure exceptions rather than discarding the underlying error cause. This provides clear diagnostic value for I/O failures such as out-of-space or permission errors, but is reasonably deferrable maintenance.
